# technitium_permissions_dhcp_server (Resource)

Manages who may view, modify and delete in the DhcpServer section. The lists set here are the section's full lists: users and groups left out lose their rights. The server always keeps `Administrators` and `DHCP Administrators` with full rights, whatever is set: leave them out, or list them with full rights. Destroying the resource leaves the permissions as they are.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "technitium_group" "perms_dhcp_server_ops" {
  name = "Ops dhcp_server"
}

# Groups the server keeps with full rights need not be listed.
resource "technitium_permissions_dhcp_server" "this" {
  group_permissions = [
    { name = technitium_group.perms_dhcp_server_ops.name, can_view = true, can_modify = false, can_delete = false },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `group_permissions` (Attributes Set) The rights of groups. The server always keeps `Administrators` and `DHCP Administrators` with full rights, whatever is set: leave them out, or list them with full rights. Leaving it out keeps the server's. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group_permissions))
- `user_permissions` (Attributes Set) The rights of individual users. An empty set removes them; leaving it out keeps the server's. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user_permissions))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import technitium_permissions_dhcp_server.this permissions_dhcp_server
```
